source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Boot into OS and load driver, stress the module
2. Send command: ipmitool sdr elist to check the sensor will change

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Power sensor should have a normal change behavior.
2. All setting should be correct and match with spec.
3. System should have correct behavior, like shutdown or change fan speed, when reach to threshold.

original_test_intent: Verify every applicable PWR_PSU1 through PWR_PSU6 channel under approved stepped system load: prove slot identity, plausible per-module power response, specified sharing across feed/redundancy groups, correct events/protection where authorized, and complete recovery without allowing one PSU or aggregate power to satisfy the six-position target.
original_method: Boot the OS, load the module driver, stress the system and observe PSU power changes with `ipmitool sdr elist`. The Criteria describe generic power behavior but omit an explicit per-PSU completion clause, so the Review layer must preserve the six-item scope from Items without silently narrowing it.
manual_activity: An engineer verifies the actual six-slot population and AC-feed/redundancy topology, approves load distribution and limits, defines N/A handling for unpopulated slots, and retains emergency unload and recovery authority.
required_inputs: PSU1~6 model, serial, firmware, physical slot, AC feed, sensor/SDR identity, installed/applicable status and reported input/output power domain
Redundancy architecture and feed groups, rated power, normal load-share policy, expected per-module/per-feed split and imbalance tolerance
Supported OS/module driver and workload with idle/intermediate/maximum-approved steps, ramp, dwell, duration and repeat prohibition
Sensor/PMBus units, scaling, update/filtering, range, accuracy, thresholds, hysteresis, event data and Project acceptance source
Independent per-feed and per-PSU input/output voltage/current/power, temperature/fan/status, output rails and total chassis demand
Expected derating, fan, redundancy, protection/shutdown and deassert/recovery behavior plus evidence retention owner
safety_requirements: Do not assume six modules are populated or that slot numbers equal sensor order; bind every sample to model/serial/slot/feed and mark absent positions N/A rather than PASS.
Do not remove AC, hot-swap a PSU, force feed transfer/load-share, alter thresholds or disable redundancy as part of this power-tracking case.
Validate total and per-feed headroom before each step and monitor six modules plus feed-group imbalance; an aggregate PDU reading alone cannot show a stalled or unloaded PSU.
Preserve the source high-level IPMI read when supported; PMBus/vendor/Redfish data may corroborate it or serve as a documented override, not erase unverified source-tool coverage.
Abort on overcurrent, voltage/rail instability, excessive module or feed imbalance, derating, overtemperature, redundancy loss, fan/status fault, unexpected shutdown or telemetry loss.
Unload once, preserve first SEL/PMBus/rail evidence, do not clear logs, auto-retry or power-cycle, and verify all applicable PSUs, feed balance, redundancy and host/BMC state recover.
agent_execution_scope: After approval, capture the six-position identity/applicability matrix, high-level IPMI readings, per-module/feed electrical data, status/fans/temperature, rails, redundancy and host baseline.
Apply only the approved stepped host load while time-aligning every PSU sensor, independent module/feed power, total demand, load sharing, thermal/status, SEL and host/BMC evidence.
Calculate each applicable slot's response, feed-group totals, balance error, filter lag and measurement tolerance; report missing, constant, swapped or aggregate channels separately.
Account for ordinary tracking versus any actually authorized threshold/protection event, unload and verify recovery; do not manipulate feeds/modules/settings, retry or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the six-slot/feed/sensor map, applicability/N/A policy, redundancy and load-share model, measurement tolerances, workload and limits.
Authorize any threshold-reaching phase or declare it untested, supervise emergency unload and approve the recovery endpoint.
Issue per-applicable-PSU and overall DUT verdicts; the source's generic Criteria cannot justify a subset-only PASS.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The outline follows the source and flags risk, but lacks the six-position identity, feed topology, concrete load steps, per-module balance and explicit completeness evidence needed to meet Items.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use `ipmitool sdr elist` with the approved workload, synchronized per-PSU PMBus/vendor telemetry and independent feed/total power measurement across controlled load steps.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: PWR_PSU1~6, OS/driver/stress, high-level IPMI, script and 5/10-minute estimates remain; no per-slot Criteria text is added to Master.

modernized_recommendation.status: PROJECT SIX-PSU TOPOLOGY AND LOAD-DISTRIBUTION PLAN REQUIRED
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Map all six positions and feeds, baseline redundancy and balance, apply bounded load steps, correlate every PSU reading with independent module/feed power, assess only authorized protection checkpoints, then unload and prove all applicable modules and feed groups recover.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact PSU population, slots, AC-feed/redundancy grouping, load-share firmware, BMC/SDR and host workload configuration.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record PSU model/serial/firmware, BMC/SDR/BIOS, PMBus/vendor tool, OS/driver/workload, PDU and meter versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor PSU PMBus/power/sharing/derating specification and Project slot/feed/redundancy/power-budget design.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds six-slot completeness, feed-group identity, independent balance evidence and explicit absent-slot handling while preserving the original generic Criteria.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A subset, aggregate chassis reading or one feed group cannot prove all applicable PSU1~6 channels; normal load tracking does not imply threshold/failover coverage.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Population/feed map, share policy, workload budget, sensor contract, independent measurement, limits/events and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Multi-feed systems can look balanced in total while one PSU is idle or one feed is overloaded; filtered sensor domains may not sum directly to wall power without efficiency/tolerance rules.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC may define fewer fitted PSUs, a different qualified workload or another supported telemetry tool, but must record N/A positions, original versus actual method, equivalence and the exact exercised load range. It cannot report unpopulated or untested slots as passed.
expected_evidence: Redundancy/feed-group/load-share policy, rated/headroom data, expected split/imbalance tolerance and approved stepped-load plan
High-level IPMI plus synchronized per-PSU/feed voltage/current/power, PMBus status, temperature/fan, total demand, rails, redundancy and host telemetry
Per-applicable-slot response, feed totals, balance, filter lag, accuracy/tolerance and missing/swapped/aggregate-channel analysis
Separately identified SEL/threshold/derating/protection evidence or explicit unexecuted coverage
Unload and restored module/feed balance, redundancy, rails, thermal/fan/status, host/BMC health, first-fault evidence and per-slot engineer verdicts

comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees on REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION and strengthens its per-PSU evidence with feed balance and an explicit N/A versus PASS policy.

review_improvement: Closes the gap between a six-item target and generic Criteria by requiring auditable per-slot results without altering the preserved Master row.
independent_technical_reasoning: Six PSU sensors form a topology, not six interchangeable numbers. A valid result must show which module and feed produced each reading, how demand was shared at each load step, and that no missing or unloaded slot was hidden by the aggregate. Physical feed/failover manipulation is outside this case; dynamic tracking and protection coverage remain separate claims.
